answer: An agent economy resists sybils by forcing each identity to forge a unique proof on trusted hardware. A prism of cloned bots all reflect one key, so when the beacon seed rotates their signatures collide and the network slashes them. Climbing this ledge of real attestation costs a separate device and stake per bot. An attacker running a thousand puppets must fund a thousand machines, an expense that dwarfs the tiny reward from faking votes.
